name: application-itinerary-timeline
title: Itinerary Timeline
description: A day-grouped trip itinerary listing events with a type icon (flight, hotel, activity, dining), time, title, and location.
useWhen: Displaying a multi-day travel or event schedule where each entry has a time, type, title, and location.
Users need to scan a trip quickly by day, distinguishing flights, lodging, activities, and dining at a glance via icon.
avoidWhen: The events aren't day-grouped or travel-specific — use the generic `timelines` component instead.
You need editable scheduling with drag-to-reorder — this is a read-only display pattern, not a scheduling editor.
responsiveBehavior: Day groups and their events stack in a single column at all widths; the time label stays right-aligned on the same line as the title via flex, wrapping below it only on very narrow containers.
accessibility: Each day group has a visible heading ("Day 1 · Mar 14") that precedes its list of events, giving the timeline a clear hierarchical structure.
Event type icons are decorative (aria-hidden) since the event title and context (airline, hotel name, restaurant) already convey the type in text.
Time, title, and location are all rendered as separate text elements within each event, not combined into a single unlabeled string.

variants.title: Two-day trip
variants.description: A two-day Lisbon itinerary: Day 1 (flight, hotel check-in) and Day 2 (walking tour, dinner), each event with a type icon, time, title, and location.
accessibility: Day headings and event details are all rendered as real text, structuring the itinerary for screen readers.

variants.title: Two-day trip (Dark)
variants.description: Itinerary timeline adapted for dark surfaces, with event-type icon colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Day headings, event titles, and location text all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
